findings.claim: Four proposed changes vs pins at f9e48c35. (1) Removing static binding: ops/lane.conf L11 WF_AGENT_DEFAULT is Claude Fable 5.1; laneconf.py REQUIRED_KEYS L81 and dispatch.sh keys L55 require the key; test_malformed_exported_wf_agent_falls_through_to_conf_default (test_dispatch_wrapper.py L1624) breaks if the key/default disappears; RowAgentIdentity plants CONF_AGENT so changing only the Fable string does not break those tests. (2) WF_AGENT_OVERRIDE ahead: `git grep WF_AGENT_OVERRIDE` empty; current order is --agent > well-formed WF_AGENT > WF_AGENT_DEFAULT (L1557-1561, test_agent_flag_beats_exported_wf_agent L1607). No test pins OVERRIDE absence; adding it ahead of WF_AGENT would invert test_exported_name_address_wf_agent_is_the_launched_identity only if OVERRIDE is set. (3) Per-session identity row in state.db: machine.py SCHEMA L68-92 is machines/transitions/subjects/marking only (created_by/agent columns, no session identity table); additive unless create() starts requiring a session. skills.py events already stamp session per event, not a session row. (4) Deriving identity from harness model at SessionStart: settings.json SessionStart runs trunk-forward.py then engine.py, neither reads WF_AGENT or model; hooks do not export env. test_instrument.py Identity pins os.environ only; test_h7_* pin USER/unknown when WF_AGENT is unset and would go red if SessionStart always set it.
